red_fitgrid.pro


Routines

top source red_fitgrid

CRISP pipeline

result = red_fitgrid(im, dx_init=dx_init, dy_init=dy_init [, /debug])

Fit pinhole positions to a rectangular grid. Robust with respect to missing (blocked) pinholes.

Return value

The grid parameters as a structure, { x0:x0, y0:y0, dx:dx, dy:dy, theta:theta}, where (X0,y0) are the pixel coordinates of one point in the grid, dx and dy are the grid spacings in X and Y resp., and theta is a rotation angle in radians.

Parameters

im in required type=array

A pinhole image.

Keywords

dx_init
dy_init
debug in optional type=boolean

Use when debugging.
